name: Ozzie Knezovich
residence: Sweetwater County (he wrote that he was born and raised in the county and later came home to serve there)
occupation: In an August 2026 Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he has 35 years of law-enforcement experience, including nearly 17 years as an elected sheriff of a prior agency, and that he had served as volunteer police chief in Superior, Wyoming
military: U.S. Army (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026, voter-guide statement)
prior_offices: He wrote that he served nearly 17 years as an elected sheriff of a prior agency (Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026; that statement did not name the agency)
background: Ozzie Knezovich ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Sweetwater County sheriff. In a Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he was born and raised in Sweetwater County, served in the U.S. Army, began a law-enforcement career here, later served nearly 17 years as an elected sheriff of a former agency, and had worked with the Wyoming Division of Criminal Investigation as volunteer police chief in Superior. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary.
